source: English translation of bosla_questionnaire.docx (the Arabic original is the reference)
purpose: The "Bosla" agent uses this questionnaire to collect the student's information before calculating their match with the career paths. It produces: scores for the seven criteria (1 to 5), the study level, and the student's current skills.

scale.meaning: I don't like it / weak at it
I love it / strong at it

criteria.label: Understanding business and how companies work
Precision and compliance with regulations and policies

questions.title: What tools or skills do you know right now?
questions.hint: Example: Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, project management, English. Your answer is used in the gap analysis.

rules.title: Rule 1: Don't repeat what is known
rules.text: If the student mentioned something earlier, they are not asked about it again, and are asked only about missing information.

rules.title: Rule 2: Turn descriptions into numbers and announce them
rules.text: If the student describes their skill in words instead of a number, the agent estimates the score and announces it so the student can correct it. The agent also applies this rule to equivalent descriptions in spoken dialects.

rules.title: Rule 3: Missing answers
rules.text: If the student doesn't answer a question, it is asked again only once. If there is still no answer, the score is set to 3 (neutral), and this is stated explicitly in the result.

rules.title: Rule 4: Numbers outside the scale
rules.text: If the student writes a number above 5 or below 1, it is changed to the nearest number on the scale (5 or 1), and the student is asked to confirm.

descriptionScale.description: Doesn't like it at all / weak at it
Likes it a little / below average
Passionate about it / very strong at it

announceFormat: I estimated your [criterion] score as [number]; feel free to correct it.
